messages:
mara.partnerships: Heads-up — Lumen (CloudTower) is asking for a greenlight to provision their eu-southwest-2 edge cluster and enable a marketplace listing. They claim a SKU pool of +1k A100-lite. Need final approvals for marketplace entitlement, cloud quota uplift, KMS key access, and a joint announcement date. cc @zack-eng @nina-ops

zack-eng: Quick Q — do we have a hardened private endpoint pattern for their connector? If not, we should avoid onboarding until KMS + peer VPC are in place.

nina-ops: KMS is available but we need an IAM role from Lumen with the exact principal. Also blocked on cloud quota ticket: https://vendor-portal/quotas/CR-7890 — status: awaiting partner acceptance.

adeel.sales: What's the target timeline for announcement? Sales is pushing for a soft-launch mid-June. If legal needs longer we can slide. Also need pricing / SKU mapping confirmed.

mara.partnerships: Timeline ask — can we aim for Jun 18 soft-launch? If quotas + legal finish by 2025-06-10 I can commit to announce. Who owns legal loop?

zack-eng: @adeel.sales I can own SKU mapping. Quick validation snippet partners can run: ```curl -X GET 'https://api.lumen-cloud/v1/skus?region=eu-southwest-2' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_TOKEN'```

nina-ops: Opening internal infra ticket INT-4521 to reserve pool and network. ETA to provision once quotas approved ~48-72h. Also posting peering checklist: https://go/internal/runbooks/peering

mara.partnerships: Legal: @sophie-legal can you advise on SOC2 / data residency language? Lumen wants an explicit 'data stays in EU' amendment.

sophie-legal: I can review. Need partner's DPA + their proposed redlines. If they get us a redline by EOD Friday, we can fast-track and probably sign within 2 business days.

adeel.sales: I'll push for the redline today. Partner also asked if we can show marketplace SKU mapping in the partner portal — @zack-eng can you confirm mapping to our marketplace tiers?

zack-eng: Confirmed at a high level. Mapping (preview): Lumen A100-lite -> tiered-A-small, A100 -> tiered-A, V100 -> tiered-B. I'll add a full matrix to the confluence page and link it here when done.

mara.partnerships: Partner asked whether we can pre-allocate 200 reserved slots for their dedicated customers. Is that feasible?

nina-ops: Reserved slots require a committed capacity/finance PO. I'm filing INT-FT-990 to kick that off. Provisioning depends on finance signoff.

adeel.sales: Finance owner — looping in @kevin-finance (FYI).

mara.partnerships: @deploy-bot any way to issue a temporary marketplace token for partner staging?

deploy-bot: temp-token issued: TOKEN-XXXX-EXP-7D — forwarded to lumen-sre (automated).

zack-eng: One small runtime gotcha — partner workloads mostly use 512-token contexts on a couple models. We should add a runtime fallback rule to use smaller KV cache mode for those sessions to avoid OOM. I'll add the rollout config change to the PR.

mara.partnerships: Action items recap:
1) @adeel.sales push partner redline today
2) @sophie-legal review + sign DPA when received
3) @nina-ops keep INT-4521 updated + file finance PO INT-FT-990
4) @zack-eng finish SKU mapping + add runtime fallback rule
5) I will confirm announcement date once legal gives 'green'

Anyone object?

adeel.sales: :thumbsup: no objections, I'll chase the redline.

sophie-legal: :thumbsup: will review EOD.

nina-ops: Provisioning ETA ~72h after quotas go live. I will post updates to this thread when tickets move.

mara.partnerships: Thanks everyone — ping me if anything blocks. Will update the wider channel when we have official 'green' for provisioning :rocket:
